entities.name: Alexandru Rusu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alexandru Rusu was a Romanian bishop of the Greek-Catholic Church. One of twelve children born to a priest in Șăulia Commune, Mureș County, he was himself ordained a priest in 1910. Rusu was ordained Bishop of Maramureş in 1931.
